# Reproduce the hydroTSM SPI/SPEI validation benchmark.
#
# This is a validation script, not package runtime code. It deliberately uses
# the optional SCI and SPEI packages without making them hydroTSM dependencies.
#
# From the hydroTSM source directory:
# Rscript inst/extdata/compare_spi_spei.R.txt values.csv.gz metadata.csv.gz

required.packages <- c("SCI", "SPEI", "zoo")
available <- vapply(required.packages, requireNamespace, quietly=TRUE,
                    FUN.VALUE=logical(1))

if (!all(available))
  stop("Install these comparison-only packages first: ",
       paste(required.packages[!available], collapse=", "))

# SCI's generalized-logistic helpers must be visible from the calling
# environment in SCI 1.0.3.
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(SCI))

arguments <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
values.file <- if (length(arguments) >= 1L) {
  arguments[1L]
} else {
    file.path(tempdir(), "spi_spei_comparison_values.csv.gz")
  }
metadata.file <- if (length(arguments) >= 2L) {
  arguments[2L]
} else {
    file.path(tempdir(), "spi_spei_comparison_metadata.csv.gz")
  }

write.comparison.csv <- function(x, file, ...) {
  if (grepl("\\.gz$", file)) {
    con <- gzfile(file, open="wt")
    on.exit(close(con), add=TRUE)
    utils::write.csv(x, con, ...)
  } else {
    utils::write.csv(x, file, ...)
  }
} # 'write.comparison.csv' END

source.file <- file.path(getwd(), "R", "spi.R")
if (file.exists(source.file)) {
  source(source.file)
  hydro.spi <- spi
  hydro.spei <- spei
  hydro.version <- read.dcf("DESCRIPTION", fields="Version")[1L]
} else {
    if (!requireNamespace("hydroTSM", quietly=TRUE))
      stop("Run from the hydroTSM source directory or install hydroTSM.")

    hydro.spi <- hydroTSM::spi
    hydro.spei <- hydroTSM::spei
    hydro.version <- as.character(utils::packageVersion("hydroTSM"))
  }

data("wichita", package="SPEI")
dates <- as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-01", wichita$YEAR, wichita$MONTH))
precipitation <- zoo::zoo(wichita$PRCP, dates)
pet <- SPEI::thornthwaite(wichita$TMED, lat=37.6475, verbose=FALSE)
water.balance <- zoo::zoo(wichita$PRCP - as.numeric(pet), dates)

precipitation.ts <- stats::ts(
  wichita$PRCP,
  start=c(wichita$YEAR[1L], wichita$MONTH[1L]),
  frequency=12
)
water.balance.ts <- stats::ts(
  zoo::coredata(water.balance),
  start=c(wichita$YEAR[1L], wichita$MONTH[1L]),
  frequency=12
)

safe.values <- function(object, n) {
  result <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(as.numeric(stats::fitted(object))),
    error=function(e) rep(NA_real_, n)
  )

  if (length(result) != n)
    result <- rep(NA_real_, n)

  result
}

scales <- c(1L, 3L, 6L, 12L)
fits <- c("max-lik", "pp-pwm", "ub-pwm")
n <- length(dates)
values <- list(date=as.character(dates))

for (scale in scales) {
  sci.spi.fit <- SCI::fitSCI(
    wichita$PRCP, first.mon=1, time.scale=scale,
    distr="gamma", p0=TRUE, scaling="sd", warn=FALSE
  )
  sci.spei.fit <- SCI::fitSCI(
    zoo::coredata(water.balance), first.mon=1, time.scale=scale,
    distr="genlog", p0=FALSE, scaling="sd", warn=FALSE
  )

  values[[paste("SCI", "SPI", "max-lik", paste0("s", scale),
                sep="__")]] <- SCI::transformSCI(
    wichita$PRCP, first.mon=1, obj=sci.spi.fit, warn=FALSE
  )
  values[[paste("SCI", "SPEI", "max-lik", paste0("s", scale),
                sep="__")]] <- SCI::transformSCI(
    zoo::coredata(water.balance), first.mon=1, obj=sci.spei.fit,
    warn=FALSE
  )

  for (fit in fits) {
    values[[paste("hydroTSM", "SPI", fit, paste0("s", scale),
                  sep="__")]] <- hydro.spi(
      precipitation, scale=scale, distribution="gamma", fit=fit,
      zero.threshold=0, p0=TRUE, scaling="sd",
      out.type="numeric", warn=FALSE
    )
    values[[paste("hydroTSM", "SPEI", fit, paste0("s", scale),
                  sep="__")]] <- hydro.spei(
      water.balance, scale=scale, distribution="genlog", fit=fit,
      p0=FALSE, scaling="sd", out.type="numeric", warn=FALSE
    )

    spei.spi <- tryCatch(
      SPEI::spi(
        precipitation.ts, scale=scale, distribution="Gamma", fit=fit,
        verbose=FALSE
      ),
      error=function(e) NULL
    )
    spei.spei <- tryCatch(
      SPEI::spei(
        water.balance.ts, scale=scale, distribution="log-Logistic",
        fit=fit, verbose=FALSE
      ),
      error=function(e) NULL
    )

    values[[paste("SPEI", "SPI", fit, paste0("s", scale),
                  sep="__")]] <- safe.values(spei.spi, n)
    values[[paste("SPEI", "SPEI", fit, paste0("s", scale),
                  sep="__")]] <- safe.values(spei.spei, n)
  }
}

values <- as.data.frame(values, check.names=FALSE)
write.comparison.csv(values, values.file, row.names=FALSE, na="")

metadata <- data.frame(
  field=c("generated", "hydroTSM", "SCI", "SPEI", "R",
          "data", "period", "observations", "PET"),
  value=c(
    as.character(Sys.Date()),
    hydro.version,
    as.character(utils::packageVersion("SCI")),
    as.character(utils::packageVersion("SPEI")),
    paste(R.version$major, R.version$minor, sep="."),
    "SPEI::wichita",
    paste(format(min(dates), "%Y-%m"), format(max(dates), "%Y-%m"),
          sep=" to "),
    as.character(length(dates)),
    "Thornthwaite; latitude 37.6475 degrees north"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors=FALSE
)
write.comparison.csv(metadata, metadata.file, row.names=FALSE)

message("Wrote comparison values to: ", normalizePath(values.file))
message("Wrote comparison metadata to: ", normalizePath(metadata.file))
